text:
maria (PM): Thinking out loud — propose a focused micro-cohort (6–8 design partners) for privacy-first customers to validate Redwood Private onboarding, KMS flows, and VPC networking. Narrow goals: reduce integration friction, prove latency/throughput SLOs in real customer networks, and lock down legal/instrumentation checklists. Wanted a quick sanity check on timeline, gating, and success metrics.

jake (Prod Eng): +1 to the narrow scope. I recommend staggered starts (2-week offsets) so infra changes don't hit everyone at once. Add an E2E metric: "time_to_first_inference" (from invite -> successful inference). Instrumentation events: `private.onboard.start`, `private.onboard.complete`, `vpc.connect_latency_ms`, `kms.rotate_attempt`.

sofia (Solutions): I can draft the outreach copy and an intake form. Proposed cohort split: 3 on-prem, 3 VPC, 1 hybrid, 1 wildcard (experimental infra). Feedback cadence: weekly async updates (thread) + biweekly live demo + one final retrospective. Also propose a 6-week pilot with optional 6-week extension.

alaa (Legal): Heads-up: include a short DPA addendum and expedited NDA for the cohort. Call out PHI explicitly in intake form: if they intend to send health data, require on-prem or signed HIPA-like attestation + extra logging controls. Sample consent phrasing below.

maria (PM): Draft success metrics (proposal):
```
- Integration time: median <= 5 days from kickoff to first successful inference
- Reliability: <= 2 service-impacting regressions per partner during pilot
- Latency: 95th pctl response time <= 150ms for typical inference paths
- Quality: no unexplained regression in top-10 prompts for each partner
- Feedback coverage: >= 80% of partners submit weekly signal (tickets + short survey)
```
If we hit all 5, consider pilot a success and discuss Dedicated capacity commitment.

jake (Prod Eng): Rollback/fallback plan: if a partner reports persistent infra issues, flip to a compatible hosted fallback model and capture diff. Feature flags to gate rollout: `pilot/private-onboard-v1`, `pilot/kms-rotation-safe-mode`. Rollback criteria: >30% partners affected by same class of failure for >24h.

sofia (Solutions): Draft intake survey (short):
```
1) Deployment type: [VPC / On-prem / Hybrid]
2) Expected peak rps (inf/sec): _____
3) Do you plan to serve regulated data? [Yes/No] (if yes, specify type)
4) Primary success criteria for you (free text)
5) Preferred weekly sync window (options)
```
Will share a first-pass outreach email shortly.

alaa (Legal): Suggested consent blurb for the intake form: 
```
By joining this pilot, you agree to provide functional feedback and logs related to Redwood Private. Redwood will treat any customer data per the DPA and will not surface customer data in aggregated public materials without explicit consent. If your traffic contains regulated data (e.g., PHI), indicate so and we will apply stricter controls or an on-prem requirement.
```
(reacts :white_check_mark:)

dp-bot: New candidate added to intake sheet: acme-health (tag: privacy, interested in KMS + VPC).

maria (PM): Next steps / owners: 
- sofia: outreach copy + intake form (EOD Tue)
- jake: instrumentation + feature-flag plan (EOD Wed)
- alaa: NDA + DPA draft + PHI wording (Thu)
- maria: cohort selection rubric and kickoff agenda (Fri)

Any objections to the 6-week core + 6-week optional extension cadence? If not, I'll post a short invite in #partners and start the intake sheet. :rocket:

jake (Prod Eng): No objections. :thumbsup:

sofia (Solutions): good with me.

alaa (Legal): fine with that timeline, will prioritize.

maria (PM): Great — I'll open the intake sheet now and tag you both. Thanks!"
